name: @nube/starter-ext-ui
description: Host-side Module Federation runtime. Forked from rubix-workspace/extension-ui-sdk's ./mf entry, with rubix-specific concepts (graph nodes, kind ids, slot path strings tied to the graph store) stripped. Provides ExtensionSlot, useExtensionHost, registerExtensionRemote, and singleton negotiation (React / react-dom / @tanstack/react-query / zustand) with matching-majors load-time refusal.
